name: Word Frequency Rank
useCase: Detecting AI text through Zipf law deviation
mechanism: Calculates trigram frequency distribution and checks compliance with Zipf's law. AI-generated text tends to deviate from natural frequency rankings.
source: Jawahar et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey
parameters: Window size: adaptive, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropy, CV, correlation
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated text
- Language-agnostic statistical approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger false positives
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies across writing styles

references.title: Jawahar et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey
